data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: I nafšayḏe ʕazəzto wa. Kətwobe uxalwo laḥmo našifo, a tloṯ danat. Yaʕni latwe hawxa šərəh. Mən d mqadmiwole muklo, uxalwo, lə məḥṭaraḏwo ʕal muklo, tə ǧara. Šərhiye latwo gabe.
data.translation: Father Brahim: His person was dear. He could eat dry bread, the three meals. That is, he was not greedy like that. Whatever food they presented to him, he would eat; he did not object to food, ever. There was no greed in him.

rationale: Fills thin established objection sense; First Infectum-wa with habitual negation and ʕal-topic. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; interpretation rests on the Turoyo.

data.turoyo: Ǧan: I naqqa d səmulle baladiye nošo mə Məḏyaḏ lə məʕṭaraḏle ‘ʕito yo‘...
data.translation: Jan: When they made it a town hall, did no one from Midyat object, “It is a church”...?

rationale: Fills thin established objection sense; Preterit with negative nošo and direct objection quotation. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; interpretation rests on the Turoyo.

data.turoyo: Hani d hawən Qəbbe, nošo d lə məḥṭarəḏ aʕlayye. Qayəm qralle l Mərde, qralle l Mawṣal, qralle l Məḏyaḏ lu Ṭuro, əmmi: "Tawu an nošaṯxu d ḥuzena... D saymina mtiḥan balki maḥtinalan ḥa mənayye Faṭəryarxo".
data.translation: These were to be the leading men, people to whom no one objected. Then they called to Mardin, they called to Mosul, they called to Midyat, to Tur Abdin; they said, “Bring your people, so that we may see... Let us hold an examination, perhaps we can appoint one of them as patriarch for ourselves.”

rationale: Fills thin established objection sense; Infectum with human target aʕlayye, broadening complement evidence. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; interpretation rests on the Turoyo.
